title: Creamy Vegetable Bake
description: This recipe is a great way of using up any small amounts of vegetables and brings them all together in a creamy, cheesy sauce. You can use whatever veg you have – root vegetables work particularly well.

ingredients.text: 1 small sweet potato, scrubbed and cut into roughly 2cm (¾ in) chunks (about 130g)
2 small leeks, trimmed, washed and cut into roughly 2cm (¾ in) chunks
1 small carrots, peeled and cut into roughly 2cm (¾ in) chunks
2 small parsnips, peeled and cut into roughly 2cm (¾ in) chunks
200g cauliflower, trimmed and broken into florets
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps:
Spray the base of a large ovenproof baking dish with low-calorie cooking
spray and add the vegetables.

In a jug, combine the ricotta, spreadable cheese, mustard powder, 200ml

water, and a pinch each of salt and pepper. Mix well. Pour over the
vegetables and stir to ensure a good coating.

Place the bread in a mini electric chopper or food processor and blitz into
fine crumbs. Spread the breadcrumbs over the vegetables to form an
even coating. Pop in the oven and cook until the top is golden and the
veg are just tender – this will take between 35–45 minutes. Take out and
serve while hot. The bake can also be frozen once cooled – defrost fully
then reheat until piping hot.
